description:
## Context

`advance/1` in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` (lines 631–638) bundles three distinct responsibilities into one private function:

```elixir
defp advance(%{exit: true} = state), do: {:stop, :normal, state}

defp advance(state) do
  state = maybe_suspend(state)       # (1) flush pending TTY side effects
  state = maybe_launch_editor(state) # (1) continued
  state = render_frame(state)        # (2) render
  {:noreply, state, loader_timeout(state)}  # (3) OTP return tuple
end
```

`handle_call({:ui_request, msg})` (L541–554) calls `render_frame` directly, bypassing `maybe_suspend` and `maybe_launch_editor`. To fix that inconsistency (ticket 5, which depends on this ticket), `flush_effects` must exist as a separately callable function.

## Change

Extract `flush_effects/1` and update `advance/1` to use it. In `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`, replace the `advance` definition at L631–638 with:

```elixir
defp flush_effects(state) do
  state |> maybe_suspend() |> maybe_launch_editor()
end

defp advance(%{exit: true} = state), do: {:stop, :normal, state}

defp advance(state) do
  state = flush_effects(state)
  state = render_frame(state)
  {:noreply, state, loader_timeout(state)}
end
```

`flush_effects/1` should be placed near `advance/1` in the private helpers section (around L620–640), before `maybe_suspend/1` and `maybe_launch_editor/1`.

This is a **pure refactoring** — `advance` behavior is identical. `flush_effects` is private (`defp`).

## Verification

- Run `mix test apps/octo_pi_tui/`. No behavior change; all existing tests must pass unchanged.
title: Extract `flush_effects/1` from `advance/1`
